description: This bar chart, titled "Model Evaluation on Academic and Practical Benchmarks," visually compares the performance of two models across eight different datasets and metrics. The horizontal axis, labeled "Dataset and Metrics," lists the evaluation benchmarks in left-to-right order: GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (x5), and Chat-Arena-Hard. The vertical axis, labeled "Score (%)," is scaled linearly from 0 to 80 in increments of 10, indicating the percentage score achieved by each model on each benchmark. The chart uses a grouped bar format, where each dataset has two adjacent bars: a blue bar representing "Llama-3-8B-it" and an orange bar representing "Ours (Iterative RLHF)". The height of each bar corresponds to its score on that specific benchmark. For GSM-8K, the blue bar reaches approximately 80% and the orange bar reaches approximately 80%. For MMLU, the blue bar is at approximately 67% and the orange bar is at approximately 66%. For HumanEval, the blue bar is at approximately 62% and the orange bar is at approximately 65%. For TruthfulQA, the blue bar is at approximately 44% and the orange bar is at approximately 60%. For ARC, the blue bar is at approximately 60% and the orange bar is at approximately 64%. For MBPP, the blue bar is at approximately 61% and the orange bar is at approximately 61%. For LC AlpacaEval-2, the blue bar is at approximately 23% and the orange bar is at approximately 31%. For MT-Bench (x5), the blue bar is at approximately 40% and the orange bar is at approximately 42%. For Chat-Arena-Hard, the blue bar is at approximately 22% and the orange bar is at approximately 30%. The bars are not sorted and are presented in the order of the dataset labels. The chart includes a legend in the top right corner that clearly associates the blue color with "Llama-3-8B-it" and the orange color with "Ours (Iterative RLHF)". There are no visual annotations or emphasis applied to any specific bars.
